scenes.section: Two main plan types: DHMO and DPPO

lines.raw: Dental plans come in the same two flavours you may know from medical plans: an **HMO** style and a **PPO** style.
lines.say: Dental plans come in the same two flavours you may know from medical plans: an H M O style and a P P O style.

scenes.section: Two main plan types: DHMO and DPPO

lines.raw: DHMO vs DPPO.
lines.say: D H M O versus D P P O.

lines.raw: Choosing a dentist. DHMO (Dental HMO): Pick **one** primary dentist from the plan's list. DPPO (Dental PPO): Any dentist; cheaper **in-network**.
lines.say: Choosing a dentist. D H M O (Dental H M O): Pick one primary dentist from the plan's list. D P P O (Dental P P O): Any dentist; cheaper in-network.

lines.raw: Out-of-network care. DHMO (Dental HMO): Usually **not covered**. DPPO (Dental PPO): Covered, but you pay more.
lines.say: Out-of-network care. D H M O (Dental H M O): Usually not covered. D P P O (Dental P P O): Covered, but you pay more.

lines.raw: What you pay. DHMO (Dental HMO): A fixed **copay** per service (e.g. $20 for a filling). DPPO (Dental PPO): **Deductible** + a **percentage** of the cost.
lines.say: What you pay. D H M O (Dental H M O): A fixed copay per service (for example 20 dollars for a filling). D P P O (Dental P P O): Deductible and a percentage of the cost.

lines.raw: Annual maximum. DHMO (Dental HMO): Often **none**. DPPO (Dental PPO): Usually **yes** (see below).
lines.say: Annual maximum. D H M O (Dental H M O): Often none. D P P O (Dental P P O): Usually yes (see below).

lines.raw: Monthly premium. DHMO (Dental HMO): Lower. DPPO (Dental PPO): Higher.
lines.say: Monthly premium. D H M O (Dental H M O): Lower. D P P O (Dental P P O): Higher.

lines.raw: Specialists. DHMO (Dental HMO): Usually need a **referral**. DPPO (Dental PPO): Usually no referral needed.
lines.say: Specialists. D H M O (Dental H M O): Usually need a referral. D P P O (Dental P P O): Usually no referral needed.

scenes.section: Two main plan types: DHMO and DPPO

lines.raw: Think of a canteen card vs a discount card.
lines.say: Think of a canteen card versus a discount card.

lines.raw: A **DHMO** is like a staff canteen card: you must eat at **one** canteen, but every item has a fixed low price.
lines.say: A D H M O is like a staff canteen card: you must eat at one canteen, but every item has a fixed low price.

lines.raw: A **DPPO** is like a discount card that works at many restaurants: you can go almost anywhere, but you pay a share of each bill, and the discount is biggest at partner restaurants.
lines.say: A D P P O is like a discount card that works at many restaurants: you can go almost anywhere, but you pay a share of each bill, and the discount is biggest at partner restaurants.

lines.raw: The 100-80-50 pattern.
lines.say: The 100-80-50 pattern.

lines.raw: Most DPPO plans sort dental services into **three groups** and pay a different share for each.
lines.say: Most D P P O plans sort dental services into three groups and pay a different share for each.

lines.raw: A very common pattern is called **100-80-50**:
lines.say: A very common pattern is called 100-80-50:

lines.raw: A typical 100-80-50 dental plan.
lines.say: A typical 100-80-50 dental plan.

lines.raw: **Preventive & diagnostic**. Examples: Check-up exam, cleaning, X-rays, fluoride for children. Plan pays: **100%**. Patient pays: 0%.
lines.say: Preventive and diagnostic. Examples: Check-up exam, cleaning, X-rays, fluoride for children. Plan pays: 100 percent. Patient pays: 0 percent.

lines.raw: **Basic**. Examples: Fillings, simple tooth removal, often root canals. Plan pays: **80%**. Patient pays: 20%.
lines.say: Basic. Examples: Fillings, simple tooth removal, often root canals. Plan pays: 80 percent. Patient pays: 20 percent.

lines.raw: **Major**. Examples: Crowns, bridges, dentures, implants. Plan pays: **50%**. Patient pays: 50%.
lines.say: Major. Examples: Crowns, bridges, dentures, implants. Plan pays: 50 percent. Patient pays: 50 percent.

lines.raw: Why preventive care is free.
lines.say: Why preventive care is free.

lines.raw: A $100 cleaning today can prevent a $1,000 root canal and crown later.
lines.say: A 100 dollars cleaning today can prevent a 1000 dollars root canal and crown later.

lines.raw: Paying **100%** for check-ups encourages people to come in twice a year, which saves the insurer money in the long run.
lines.say: Paying 100 percent for check-ups encourages people to come in twice a year, which saves the insurer money in the long run.

lines.raw: Plans differ.
lines.say: Plans differ.

lines.raw: Which service sits in which group is a **plan decision**.
lines.say: Which service sits in which group is a plan decision.

lines.raw: Root canals, for example, are "basic" in some plans and "major" in others.
lines.say: Root canals, for example, are "basic" in some plans and "major" in others.

lines.raw: Always read the plan's own **benefit summary**; never assume.
lines.say: Always read the plan's own benefit summary; never assume.

lines.raw: Key takeaways.
lines.say: Key takeaways.

lines.raw: In the US, dental care is usually covered by a **separate dental plan** with its own card and claims.
lines.say: In the U S, dental care is usually covered by a separate dental plan with its own card and claims.

lines.raw: **DHMO**: one chosen dentist, fixed copays, often no annual maximum.
lines.say: D H M O: one chosen dentist, fixed copays, often no annual maximum.

lines.raw: **DPPO**: any dentist, deductible plus a percentage, usually an annual maximum.
lines.say: D P P O: any dentist, deductible plus a percentage, usually an annual maximum.

lines.raw: Many DPPO plans follow **100-80-50**: preventive 100%, basic 80%, major 50%.
lines.say: Many D P P O plans follow 100-80-50: preventive 100 percent, basic 80 percent, major 50 percent.

lines.raw: The **annual maximum** caps what the **plan** pays each year; after it is used up, the member pays the full fee until the plan year resets.
lines.say: The annual maximum caps what the plan pays each year; after it is used up, the member pays the full fee until the plan year resets.
